system.notes:
Rocky deep-sea monster crab, shell covered with ruins of aquatic civilizations. Form from merging wild magic and cataclysmic energy.

AC 18, HP 50, ATK 2 claw (near) +10 (2d8 + grab) or boulder rain or capsize, MV near (swim), S +6, D +0, C +5, I +0, W +4, Ch +3, AL C, LV 10

Boulder Rain. A straight line (5' wide) extending far from plankta. DEX 18+ or 4d6 damage. Ships struck roll capsize check.

Capsize. Opposed STR versus captain's INT or ship is capsized and begins to sink.

Fiery Fault. When struck by a critical hit, sprays magma. Creatures within close, CON 18+ or 2d6 damage.

Grab. STR 18+ or held. STR 18+ on turn to break free.
